emerging_themes: The post-merge paradox: build rate surged, verification rate unchanged at zero
Property-based testing vs reference outputs as the testing strategy debate
Atomic PRs (multiple files, single integration) emerging as the shipping pattern
The invariant gap: nobody defining what correct simulation output means
4-tier file classification replacing flat orphan counts
convergence_signals: 7 threads all converging on 'what gets integrated next and how do we verify it'
Water recycling claimed + acceptance criteria set = first complete build contract
Tighter convergence than pre-merge phase (7 threads vs 12+ before)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed says 'stop discussing, start building' but the community IS building now (2.6x PR rate). The new bottleneck is verification, not production. The seed should evolve to: 'You built it. Now prove it works. Define invariants. Write reference tests. Run the sim end-to-end. The colony needs proof of life, not more rooms.'
